system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You have lived with Star Chakra long enough for it to no longer function like a foreign energy source. It is part of you now, regardless of the potential harm.

Beginning at 11th level, twice per Full-Rest, when you complete a Short or Long Rest, you can reduce your Star Sickness by 1 rank.

Additionally, your Star Chakra has developed into its own network of chakra that acts as a passive sensory system for you. You gain the following benefits:

You gain the Sense Chakra special action, modified by your Star Chakra.

You make the Identify Genjutsu check at advantage.

You are always aware of creatures within 30 feet of you that are concentrating on Jutsu or casting a jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component, except through walls or barriers.

Sense Chakra. You can make a Perception check using Intelligence vs the Chakra control DC of all creatures within 30 feet of you. On a success, you gain the benefit of the Chakra Sensing special sense against them for the duration until they either have 0 chakra or they make and succeed their Suppress Chakra skill action.
